fields.Front: What are chained (extended) dominants?

fields.Front: What is a courtesy (cautionary) accidental?
fields.Back: A reminder, often in brackets, after a bar line cancelled an accidental, e.g. (♮) on F in the bar after an F♯. It changes nothing; it just prevents mistakes.

fields.Front: Hands-together reading habit — how do you read two staves at once?
fields.Back: Read each beat bottom-up as one vertical event (bass note, then treble), not one hand's line and then the other.
